limits: Animal species labels are provisional; accuracy is not scored.
Six paired sources are exploratory and do not qualify development or held-out groups.
One outcome per source and arm cannot separate processing effects from provider variability.
The two arms change anti-alias filtering and partial-tail measurement together.
Slots 1–7 and 8–12 ran in separate execution segments after an app replacement; the stream pair crosses that gap.
Native confidence and displayed match are not calibrated probabilities.
Cost estimates cover observed primary attempts only and are not an invoice or complete billing ledger.
Passive tools submitted no requests; twelve ordinary Identify taps submitted the comparisons.
Visible labels are supplemental UI observations; their file hashes do not cryptographically bind biological labels to provider results.
The authenticated receipt joins the admitted measurement to finalization and rendering; it is not independent biological review.
No raw provider prose, media, coordinates, owner IDs, scan IDs, auth state, or private configuration values are retained.
Ordinary Gemini routing and current audio processing remain unchanged.
